_purpose: Named, per-line exceptions to check_refs' path resolution (R18), read by scripts/keel_checks.py. Each entry names a file, a line and the exact unresolved path that line cites; --refs still fails on any unresolved path not listed here, including a different line of a file that already has an entry. Deliberately JSON, not markdown: check_refs only scans path-shaped citations inside tracked *.md files, so a nonexistent path can be named here without that naming becoming a fresh citation the checker tries to resolve. A listed entry whose violation no longer occurs is itself a failure (a stale waiver) — see check_refs' docstring.
